facts.fact: Planete 7 quotes the Enabel project head saying 10 pilot communes in Conakry, Kindia and Mamou have benefited from the digital civil registration project, about 80 agents were trained, and it now extends to 28 communes.
facts.system: Guinea civil registration digitalisation pilot project
